raw_recipe.headline: Jezebel Sauce
raw_recipe.description: This jezebel sauce is a surprisingly sweet and spicy spread that's wonderful served over cream cheese with crackers.

video.description: Using only a handful of simple ingredients, you can create a sweet and spicy sauce that makes for a great appetizer topper! In this video, Nicole shows you how to make jezebel sauce using fruit preserves and prepared horseradish. This sauce is best served as either a quick snack with cheese and crackers or as a flavor enhancer alongside smoky meats.
video.name: How to Make Jezebel Sauce

raw_recipe.name: Jezebel Sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Mix apple jelly, pineapple fruit preserves, prepared horseradish, ground dry mustard, cracked black pepper, and crushed red pepper together in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours, or overnight, before serving.

review.reviewBody: I've been making a variation of this for years. My recipe calls for 1/4 cup of dry mustard and only 5 oz. of horseradish and it has quite a bite so I wouldn't use the 8 oz. of horseradish called for in this recipe unless you want it VERY hot. Update: Try this as a sauce with pork tenderloin or roasted chicken.

This is definetly different! I will make again, but with theses changes. First off cut this recipe in 1/2! I mixed it in with the cream cheese (as opposed to drizzling over) and started with 2oz of horseradish, I also added minced sweet red peppers for texture and color. I made it the night before to let all the flavors come together and served with tortilla chips, all of my guests raved about this and it was gone in a hour. I think next time I will add a tbsp of strawberry preserves for a different flavor. Enjoy!

Loved it. I bumped up the quanities, brought everything to a low boil, then canned and processed for gifting. Held up beautifully. Looks gorgeous in the jar. And my is it ever tasty. Used it as a dipping sauce for chicken and with ham slices. Great! Will make again and again!

I ran out of dry mustard, but I always keep Inglehoffer's sweet hot mustard in the fridge. I also keep Beaver brand hot honey mustard (same flavor). I add 2tsp each worstershire and tamari and use an immersion blender. We serve it with homemade shrimp/crab Rangoon egg rolls. The sauce is always a hit!

This is great! Sweet and spicy hot!! Will certainly cure what ails you! It makes your eyes water and your nose run. The only thing I did differently was to gently heat everything together before refrigerating before use. A KEEPER!
I made mine with a Brie round rather than cream cheese. Baked it at 359 degrees for 45 minutes. Awesome!

I make my own horseradish, gas mask or outside(!). it’s basically a confined weed in my chicken run. (Young greens add a subtle horseradish bite to salads and sandwiches). Anyway, it’s Hot, by design, so I use about half that called for in this recipe. It’s “Gone in sixty seconds”. Great appetizer! Funny, making “Jezebel” sauce for my mother’s women’s Bible study group🤣🤣🤣. I’ve used Cranberry, instead of apple jelly, great on the mini ham sandwiches and/or crackers! I use freshly ground mustard, much potential sinus opening elements here, but the cream cheese, fresh refrigerator pineapple and lemon tame it nicely. It’s also great served on pineapple planks!

I'm from Australia so I couldn't find apple jelly. I ended up making the apple jelly & the pineapple preserve. I served the Jezebel sauce on Christmas day with ham on the bone. I love it and will definitely make it again

I am 88 and I have made this recipe minus the black pepper and red peppers for 68 years. I make a very large batch 5 times this. Put it in small mason jars and give as a gift to my friends at Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas. It's great on a baked ham glaze. Have given as gifts for Christmases to my children's & grandchildrens school teachers. Never a complaint have a holliday recipe card I printed out with the recipe. 🙏🦃🦌

I've made this for years but I use apricot preserves instead of the apple jelly and I don't add the dry mustard. This is fantastic served over grilled pork tenderloin. Guests inevitably request the recipe.
I’ve always used apricot preserves instead of pineapple and apple jelly. Simple and delicious!

I’ve made this most of my adult life and recipes vary from apricot, pineapple preserves, to apple jelly or orange marmalade. My fav protein is pineapple orange combo. It is deeeeelish! Horseradish can be tweaked to your taste more or less.
I made this exactly to recipe- it was so hot that it was inedible. Eyes were watering and nose burning. I guess I should have added the horseradish and mustard a little at a time. Live and learn!
This tasted horrendous and did not look like the picture at all. Used all ingredients as listed.
In our family we use apricot preserves instead of apple and pineapple.

Love it with ham for Easter with sweet potatoes and my broccoli/corn/stuffing casserole. Also, has anyone ever added a handful of raisins (bakers raisins) makes that special sauce with thick slabs of ham

I made this to go with our spiral ham as I was worried the ham would be dry. It wasn’t , and this was an ahhhmazing sauce to compliment the ham. I like a little horseradish with pot roast but generally don’t do hot or spicy. THIS is a huge exception. Everyone loved it and several asked for the recipe. I like others couldn’t find pineapple jam so I used peach and follow the rest of the recipe as written. Wishing I’d brought a little home for me !

It is a hit whenever I serve it and it is gluten free!!! The recipe is requested so often that I now carry it with me to the parties. The sweet and spicy hot, added atop cream cheese if you choose, is a surprise and attracts most people. I intentionally pour overflow onto the plate when I use cream cheese brick so non dairy folk can skip the cheese. I can’t handle jalapeño spicy but I love this. Sometimes it takes someone who has had it before to encourage others, or if you can get a brave person to try it first the rest will follow. I usually bring home an empty tray. Black Diamond cracked pepper gluten free crackers are my fave dippers and/or celery. Usually I have to contact more than one grocery store to get the jelly and preserves. Some are willing to order it. The last time the challenge amidst covid was apple jelly. Walmart had it. Enjoy!
